description: Host for an installed custom component. No FieldMapping surface observed via the generic API — custom components configure through their own installed manifest, not generic Property nodes.
notes: Installing a custom component is a UI-only zip upload (npx + lcnc-sdk-js tooling) with no API route — this shape is only the bare, unconfigured host Component; there is nothing further to capture generically since each custom component defines its own config surface.

Real ids typically use the manifest_id prefix only on a fresh single-widget add (e.g. `Button_<10-char-rand>`, `Metrics_<10-char-rand>`) — the scenario this template mints for — while built-up production pages (`all_pages_draft_20260806.json`) mostly carry the generic `Component_<rand>` id instead, and Repeater/Tab/MasterDetail/Breadcrumbs were never observed prefixed at all.
